title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: September 9, 2026 - Reflecting September 8th Close and September 9th Pre-Market Indications

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Slide on September 8th Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Surging Oil; Mixed Pre-Market for September 9th
items.summary: U.S. equity markets ended Tuesday, September 8, with significant declines across major indices as persistent geopolitical tensions, particularly the U.S.-Iran conflict and U.S.-Canada trade friction, pushed crude oil prices higher. The S&P 500, NASDAQ, and Dow Jones Industrial Average all closed lower. As of early Wednesday, September 9, pre-market trading shows a mixed outlook, with oil prices continuing to climb past $100 a barrel, while individual stock movers like Meta Platforms demonstrated strong gains. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Intel Surges on Price Hike Plans
items.summary: Intel Corporation ($INTC) shares climbed over 9% after the company announced plans to raise processor prices by up to 10% to improve its margins.

items.headline: Corning Rises on Verizon Fiber Deal
items.summary: Corning Inc. ($GLW) gained over 7% after securing a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar agreement to supply 80 million miles of high-density optical fiber to Verizon Communications, supporting broadband expansion and AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Amgen Drops on Drug Trial Setback
items.summary: Amgen ($AMGN) shares slid over 10% following news of a Phase 3 trial setback for Novartis' pelacarsen injectable, a heart disease drug. Analysts are concerned Amgen's similar treatment, olpasiran, could face a similar outcome.

items.headline: Novartis Plummets After Pelacarsen Trial Failure
items.summary: Novartis ($NVS) stock fell sharply by nearly 14% after the company reported a Phase 3 trial setback for its pelacarsen injectable, a drug intended to treat heart disease.

items.headline: Casey's General Store Dips on Conservative Guidance
items.summary: Casey's General Store ($CASY) saw its shares decline by nearly 10% after the company, despite beating analyst earnings expectations, provided conservative guidance.

items.headline: Inflation Worries Mount Ahead of Fed Meeting; Rate Hike Odds Increase
items.summary: Surging oil prices, with Brent crude nearing $100 a barrel, intensified inflation concerns ahead of crucial Producer Price Index (PPI) and Consumer Price Index (CPI) data due later this week. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's recent remarks on persistent inflation have led traders to price in a higher probability (around 60%) of a 25-basis-point rate hike at the upcoming September FOMC meeting.

items.headline: Geopolitical Tensions Drive Oil Surge and Market Caution
items.summary: Geopolitical developments, including the ongoing U.S.-Iran conflict and escalating U.S.-Canada trade friction, significantly impacted market sentiment on September 8th. The Middle East tensions pushed crude oil prices to multi-week highs, contributing to broader market declines.

items.headline: Energy Leads, Healthcare Lags in Sector Performance
items.summary: On September 8th, the Energy sector was the top performer, gaining over 1%, driven by higher oil prices. Utilities and Technology also saw modest gains. Conversely, the Healthcare sector was the worst performer, falling over 2.5%, largely due to drug trial setbacks. Financials and Materials also experienced declines.

items.headline: United Natural Foods Reports Mixed Fiscal 2026 Results
items.summary: United Natural Foods, Inc. ($UNFI) announced its fourth quarter and full year fiscal 2026 results on September 8th. The company reported a 2.0% decrease in full-year net sales to $31.2 billion, while adjusted EPS increased to $2.65 for the full year and $0.69 for the fourth quarter.

items.headline: Meta Surges in Pre-Market on AI Agent Launch; Futures Mixed
items.summary: U.S. stock futures for September 9th showed a mixed performance, with S&P 500 and Dow futures generally down, while Nasdaq futures were slightly positive or flat depending on the reporting time. Meta Platforms ($META) shares jumped 3.6% in pre-market trading following the official launch of Muse, its autonomous artificial intelligence personal agent. Conversely, Evommune ($EVMN) shares fell 13.9% after its drug candidate failed a Phase 2b trial. Oil prices continued to climb, breaching $100 a barrel.
